title: Unvoice
tagline: Remove custom voices from any mod and let SkyrimNet re-voice it.
description:
As of SkyrimNet 1.3.1, voices from certain mods are blacklisted, after someone requested it.

**This doesn't change that.**

While I may strongly disagree with said person, I'm not going to try to bypass it. My solution is the opposite: *Remove her voice from the mods,* and let SkyrimNet's Universal Translator re-voice her using whatever voice you set for the character instead. This fixes the problem of inconsistent voices between pre-recorded lines and SkyrimNet dialogue, without working around the blacklist.

It could also be used for mods with poor voice quality, or if you use the new "Design a Voice" feature to re-voice someone.

This is done using only a single SKSE plugin. No redistribution, modification, unpacking, viewing, or downloading of said mods was required in the making of it. It contains absolutely no copyrightable content from said mods.

The list of plugins is set in the `Unvoice.ini` file; the default is the two currently blacklisted by SkyrimNet.

Tested on 1.6.1170, but should theoretically work on 1.7.104 and other 1.5-1.7 versions. It won't work on VR currently.
author: maeyanie
changelog: Initial public beta, tested on SkyrimNet 1.3.0 and 1.3.1.
